notes.made: Ferry wrote and produced it with Rhett Davies, and it's the track where the New York players come through: the album credits give Nile Rodgers on lead guitar, Marcus Miller on bass, Andy Newmark on drums and David Sanborn on saxophone. Mixing was by Bob Clearmountain, mastering by Bob Ludwig.
notes.context: The second single, out in August 1985, reached 21 in the UK, top 20 on Billboard's album rock list and 26 on the Adult Contemporary chart. John Scarlett-Davis directed the video, mostly silhouettes of the model Laurence Treil over old film of dancers. In 2013 it came back as three limited 12-inches of remixes by Todd Terje, Idjut Boys, Greg Wilson and Derek Kaye and others.
